title: Grand opening
news: Burrito Cart Co. opens in Salsa Springs! Customers in each building will walk to the nearest truck, but the farther they have to go, the fewer of them make the trip. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Business is picking up
news: Word is out. More buildings want burritos today, and the crowds are bigger. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Cheese shortage
news: A cheese-supply disruption pushes ingredient costs up. Same city as yesterday. Should you open more trucks, or fewer? Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $7 in ingredients.

title: Rainy day
news: It is pouring. Customers will not walk nearly as far for a burrito today. Same city and costs as Day 2. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Festival weekend
news: The downtown festival draws huge crowds to the city center. With 56 possible spots, there are about 72 quadrillion ways to place trucks. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Forecasts only
news: From now on the numbers are forecasts. Actual demand is random and revealed after you click Done. The error bars show the range it will fall in. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Concert night
news: A concert at Stochastic Stadium might sell out, or it might rain out. The forecast is huge, but so is the uncertainty. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Permit fees up
news: The city raised street-vending permit fees, so every truck costs more today. Each truck costs $320 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Heat wave
news: A heat wave hits the east side. People there may come out in bigger numbers than forecast. Notice the lopsided error bars. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.

title: Marathon morning
news: A marathon closes streets in the north. Forecasts there are probably too optimistic: demand is more likely to come in below them. Each truck costs $250 for the day. Each burrito sells for $10 and costs $5 in ingredients.
